description: Treat Turing machine transition tables as genomes. Apply genetic algorithm operators (crossover, mutation, selection) to evolve machines that score highly on sigma/step metrics.
mathematical_formalization: fitness(M) = log(sigma(M)) if halts(M) else -inf; select top-k, crossover at random transition boundary
implementation_hypothesis: Tournament selection on sigma score, single-point crossover splitting transition table, mutation rate ~1/num_transitions
experiment_seed: Start from known BB(4) and BB(5) champions, evolve toward higher sigma in 6-state space
